summary: An update interrupted by Azure no longer leaves your installation half on the old version.

fixes.title: Updates retry when Azure does not answer
fixes.text: When Azure does not answer a request during an update, the update tries it once more instead of stopping. Starting a job is never sent twice.

fixes.title: A stopped update finishes within minutes
fixes.text: If an update still stops part way, the next check finishes it within minutes. Until then, the update's run shows which parts are on which version.
